aboutNmn.heading: What exactly is NMN?
body: NMN is the abbreviation for nicotinamide mononucleotide. It is a nucleotide built around nicotinamide, and a substance that is naturally present in the body.
Within the body it is positioned as one of the precursors of a coenzyme called NAD+ (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide).

NAD+ is a coenzyme first identified in the early 1900s. How it is produced within the body and how it is used are questions still being studied today at universities and research institutions in Japan and abroad.

What happens when you consume a food containing this ingredient, however, is something we are limited in what we may say as food advertising. So what this page conveys is information about how the product is made: its raw material, its manufacturing and its quality control.
NMN KIWAMI is a nutritional supplement. It is not a pharmaceutical.

items.a: NMN stands for nicotinamide mononucleotide, a substance that is also naturally present in the body. NMN KIWAMI is a nutritional supplement containing this ingredient.

items.q: How does it differ from other NMN products?
items.a: NMN KIWAMI uses NMN raw material produced in Japan and is manufactured at a facility certified under JIHFS Health Food GMP. Purity analysis is carried out for every production lot, and the capsule is an acid-resistant capsule made from plant-based materials. Each capsule is individually sealed in PTP packaging and stored in an aluminium gusset bag. Its defining feature is a quality design that spans everything from the raw material to how it is stored.

items.q: How much NMN does NMN KIWAMI contain?
items.a: It contains 21,600 mg of NMN per box of 90 capsules, or 240 mg per capsule.
As a dietary supplement, take 2 to 3 capsules per day.
There is no particular rule about when to take it. Please take it with water or lukewarm water.

items.q: Can I take it while on medication?
items.a: If you are taking medication or under medical care, please consult your physician in advance.

items.q: Can I take it while pregnant or breastfeeding?
items.a: Those who are pregnant or breastfeeding, as well as infants and children, should refrain from taking this product.
Store away from direct sunlight, high temperature and high humidity. Once opened, please consume it as soon as possible, and keep it out of the reach of infants.

Sealing each capsule individually in PTP packaging means only what is needed is opened, so unopened capsules are less exposed to the air. The sheets are then stored in an aluminium gusset bag designed to block light and moisture.

items.q: Why is it priced this way?
items.a: NMN raw material produced in Japan, 21,600 mg per box, purity analysis for every production lot, a plant-based acid-resistant capsule, individual PTP packaging and an aluminium gusset bag. The price is the result of accumulating a quality design that spans the raw material through to storage.
